Australia is the only regulator in the world that publishes field trial sites. Position is a state centroid, not the site — APHIS publishes release states, never coordinates.

-123.09200,44.06390.name: The Fertility Center of Oregon
-123.09200,44.06390.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Douglas J. Austin, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-48.54685,-27.58972.name: CLINIFERT
-48.54685,-27.58972.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: www.clinifert.com.br. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.

37.07000,0.47000.name: Rhino and wildlife biobanking — BioRescue partners
37.07000,0.47000.desc: The programme attempting to produce northern white rhinos from banked cells and harvested eggs, with two females alive and no males. It has created viable embryos and has not yet produced a calf. If it works it is the first species brought back from functional extinction; if it does not, it is the clearest demonstration that banking material is not the same as saving a species.

-84.51200,39.13100.name: Medpace

7.87220,46.20440.name: Lonza — capacity allocation and Moderna
7.87220,46.20440.desc: Lonza’s disclosures on contract manufacturing capacity, including the arrangements that produced billions of vaccine doses. Which products get made, and when, is decided in private commercial negotiation — during a shortage that is a rationing decision by a company no health authority appoints.

-93.09000,44.95370.name: Makana Therapeutics (Recombinetics)
-93.09000,44.95370.desc: Engineers pigs for organ and islet-cell transplantation, from a company whose hornless-cattle work produced the case that changed US policy: FDA found bacterial DNA in the edited cattle that the developers had not detected, which became the standard argument for why edited animals should stay inside regulation.

4.46800,51.91000.name: Erasmus MC — Fouchier laboratory
4.46800,51.91000.desc: Made H5N1 avian influenza transmissible between ferrets by air in 2011, work that triggered the first global argument about whether some results should be published at all. The US paused funding for this class of research for three years afterwards. Nothing else on this map is a case of an organism being made more dangerous on purpose and the reasoning being that you cannot defend against what you have not built.
